results.title: Daddy's in Trouble
results.overview: Roberta is tired of taking care of the house and the kids all by herself, so she decides to take a vacation, leaving her husband to look after the children. The result is that the house is turned upside down as Fred tries to balance family demands with his work responsibilities. Amid laughter and chaos, the film shows how a family can overcome challenges when they stick together.

results.title: Six Pack XXX - 30 Years of Band
results.overview: A documentary film which follows the band Six Pack through three decades of work, from the first gigs in their hometown to the big stages. Intimate confessions of the band members, archival recordings and the energy of live performances are folded into one story.

results.title: Tough Luck
results.overview: ​Arrested by mistake and mistaken for France’s most wanted man, Serge Martin, a peaceful retiree, becomes the target of the media. Caught up in a never-ending whirlwind, he’ll do everything he can to prove his innocence and get his life back… if that’s even possible!

results.title: AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
results.original_title: AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
results.overview: Comedy trailblazer Eddie Murphy celebrates his legendary film career in this star-studded tribute filmed live in Los Angeles.

results.title: Godmother
results.overview: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

results.title: Rainbow on Mars
results.overview: Pelangi is an Indonesian child born on Mars. Together with her robot friends, she embarks on a great journey that will determine the future of Earth. Can they overcome it?

results.title: The Dating App Killer: The Monica White Story
results.original_title: The Dating App Killer: The Monica White Story
results.overview: A divorcee reenters the dating pool by creating an online profile, but when her match displays unsettling behavior and a series of women from the same dating site go missing, she must save herself from becoming the next victim.

results.title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 5
results.original_title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 5
results.overview: The fifth night of Road to The New Beginning 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on February 1, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Arctic Heroes
results.overview: During excavations on Wrangel Island, a living baby mammoth is discovered, sleeping in a man-made cryogenic sarcophagus. The obsessed scientist leading the expedition decides to keep the discovery secret from the public and pass it off as the result of his cloning work. The baby mammoth is to be dissected to obtain material for cloning and research. Young schoolchildren come to the aid of the baby mammoth, accidentally discovering that it is intelligent. They help the baby mammoth escape and return to Wrangel Island to uncover the mystery of its origin.

results.title: Obscure Identity
results.overview: In an era of sensory overload and conspiracy, the line between truth and delusion is razor thin. When a woman is stuck in the liminal space of an airport baggage claim, she must know the difference before paranoia (or worse) consumes her.

results.title: Kill Harry
results.overview: Harry captures the magic at Muni and explores the cuts with an undeniable roster of Philly stars. Panebianco, Ward, O'Dwyer and more—this is essential East Coast viewing.

results.title: Kommissar Jennerwein – Hochsaison
results.overview: Jennerwein has barely started his job in Garmisch-Partenkirchen when a Danish ski jumper falls to his death, the president of the Winter Games Committee narrowly escapes an assassination attempt, and anonymous letters announce further crimes. Amidst suspicious villagers and vain local politics, Jennerwein must unmask a perpetrator who craves attention and is playing a deadly serious game.

results.title: Capturing Bigfoot
results.overview: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

results.title: The Last Roman God
results.overview: Through both personal and political conflicts, the film tells the story of emperor Diocletian's rise to power and his complicated place in ancient Rome's court politics.

results.title: Ghost Board
results.original_title: กล่องผีสุ่มวิญญาณ
results.overview: A group of friends stumbles upon an ancient board game hidden in a remote temple. Once the die is cast, a vengeful spirit is unleashed, turning the game into a deadly trap. To survive, they must figure out how to end it before they become its next victims.

results.title: Ashes
results.overview: Lucila leaves Mexico with her younger brother to reunite with their mother in Madrid, who had left a few years earlier to chase a better future. When they finally arrive, the bitter, suffocating reality that awaits them proves far harsher than Lucila had imagined. Still, she is determined to make the most of this fragile new life.

results.title: Passing Place
results.overview: A woman awakes on a surreal purgatorial island after being mistakenly declared dead.

results.title: Dummy
results.overview: Archibald the Amazing, a ventriloquist nearing the end of his career, gives one final performance with his dummy, Chucklehead. After the show, he tragically takes his own life in his hotel room-but his negative energy inhabits Chucklehead, transforming the dummy into a murderous force of terror. From a class reunion to hotel staff to unsuspecting bystanders, Chucklehead embarks on a blood-soaked rampage, vowing to make it a night to remember.

results.title: The Virgin of the Quarry Lake
results.overview: On the eve of the 2001 outbreak, a young woman falls for her lifelong friend but turns to incantations and curses with her grandmother's help when a more experienced rival threatens their romance.

results.title: The Brainstorm
results.overview: Rosalie tries to make a film, while her roommate and her actors keep getting in her way.
